milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate near the birch button (mounted on the oak pillar at relative position 3,1,-3) and face it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining acacia_stairs with a pickaxe drops the acacia_stairs item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 acacia_stairs in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms they mined a block. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because mining black_wool (with shears or by hand) drops the black_wool item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 black_wool in inventory, so having at least 3 confirms they mined enough wool for the bed recipe (3 wool needed to dye into 3 light_gray_wool). This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a light_gray_bed places it in the player's inventory. The player must first craft light_gray_wool (black_wool + light_gray_dye) then combine 3 light_gray_wool + 3 acacia_planks in the crafting table to produce the bed. The player starts with 0 light_gray_bed, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
